summary: JBS N.V., a Netherlands-based meat packer, submitted a non-binding proposal on August 18, 2026, to acquire all outstanding shares of Pilgrim's Pride Corporation (PPC) not already owned by JBS or affiliates. JBS currently owns ~82% of PPC. The offer is an all-stock fixed exchange ratio of 2.086 JBS Class A shares per PPC share. No price per share or premium is stated. The proposal is non-binding; no agreement guaranteed. If consummated, JBS would own 100% of PPC. Watch for special committee evaluation, fairness opinion, negotiated terms, and required regulatory approvals. Risk-arb hinges on final exchange ratio and closing timeline.
